subject: PoC kickoff: private VPC required — trial plan & immediate next steps (NimbleHealth)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brooks <alex.brooks@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: PoC kickoff: private VPC required — trial plan & immediate next steps (NimbleHealth)

Hi Alex — thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the PoC plan:  

Summary of needs you shared:
- PHI handling and HIPAA constraints — must be isolated, no public internet egress from model hosts.
- Prefer customer-managed VPC or on-prem (Private VPC).
- Pilot window target: 6 weeks from kickoff.
- Key success criteria: HIPAA-compliant audit trail, p95 inference latency < 100ms for standard prompts, functional parity with current baseline, and cost envelope target (TBD).

Proposed Redwood response / PoC options (we can pick one path based on your preference):
1) Private VPC PoC (recommended): deploy Redwood Private control plane with customer VPC peering (AWS), dedicated inference nodes inside your VPC, KMS key integration, and audit log export. Typical timeline: 2-week infra setup + 4-week trial validation.
2) Dedicated capacity (our hosted Dedicated in a private tenancy): faster to spin up, still isolated but requires cross-account networking. Good fallback if on-prem constraints delay networking.
3) Hosted API: not viable given PHI requirement but we can scope a redacted-data trial if you want to test model behavior quickly.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Please confirm the preferred PoC mode (Private VPC vs Dedicated capacity) by EOD Thu so we can schedule SRE slots.
- Share security contact for questionnaire + any current SOC2/HIPAA docs you require (I noted Jillian in the call).
- Availability for a 30-min kickoff next week? Proposed windows: Wed 10am-12pm or Thu 2pm-4pm PT.

I attached a short PoC-Checklist that outlines infra prerequisites and typical SOW tasks. Once you confirm mode and availability I will loop in our Solutions Engineering lead (Marissa) and infra (Karthik) to draft a detailed timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PoC-Checklist.pdf (summary of milestones, infra items, and gating criteria)

From: Alex Brooks <alex.brooks@nimblehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Jillian Park <jillian.park@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PoC kickoff: private VPC required — trial plan & immediate next steps (NimbleHealth)

Rachel — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming constraints from my side and adding a couple of asks:  

1) PoC mode: Private VPC is required. We cannot use any public-hosted endpoints for PHI processing.
2) Timeline: 6-week pilot from kickoff is realistic but network/VPC peering and security review are our gating items — we need to include our security lead (Jillian) on the kickoff.
3) Audit/compliance: We will need audit log exports, KMS integration, and a written outline of where data at rest / in motion will reside.
4) Performance: target p95 inference latency < 100ms for our short consumer prompts.
5) Commercial: please send an SSPA or an example enterprise addendum (we can run internal procurement in parallel).

Contacts: Jillian Park, Security Lead — jillian.park@nimblehealth.com (cc'd). For procurement you can loop in contracts@nimblehealth.com.

Attached is our risk profile spreadsheet — it lists the controls and the specific evidence we'll ask for during the evaluation.

We can do kickoff Thu 11am PT — works for Jillian and me. Please confirm and include the SRE/solutions engineer attendees.

- Alex
VP Product, NimbleHealth
alex.brooks@nimblehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0219

Attachment: nimble_risk_profile.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Alex Brooks <alex.brooks@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PoC kickoff: private VPC required — trial plan & immediate next steps (NimbleHealth)

Thanks Alex — glad to have Jillian looped in. Quick engineering note and proposed plan from Redwood Solutions:  

Prelim plan for Private VPC PoC:
- Week 0–1: Network setup & validation — create customer-managed VPC, establish VPC peering or PrivateLink, exchange routing and firewall rules. Redwood will provide a VPC template and required CIDR ranges. (Attachment: redwood_poc_vpc_template.docx)
- Week 2: Control plane & key management — configure Redwood Private control plane, KMS integration, and audit export pipeline to your S3/logging endpoint.
- Week 3–6: Load testing, latency tuning, and functional validation against your prompt set. We'll run representative traffic to validate p95 latency and monitor costs.
- Deliverables: deployment runbook, audit log samples, and a post-PoC performance summary.

Required from NimbleHealth for Week 0:
- VPC contact and an account with the right IAM permissions to create peering/roles.
- Security questionnaire completed (we will send).
- Signed SSPA (procurement can work in parallel).

Staffing & attendees for kickoff (Thu 11am PT):
- Redwood: Rachel Kim (AE), Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng), Karthik Iyer (SRE Lead)
- NimbleHealth: Alex Brooks (VP Product), Jillian Park (Security Lead), procurement rep (optional)

I will bring the VPC template and a short runbook to the kickoff so we can agree on CIDRs and firewall rules live. If Thu 11am PT is confirmed I'll send the calendar invite with dial-in and a link to the SSPA request placeholder.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_poc_vpc_template.docx
